title: New draft deal aims to avert collapse of talks at COP31 climate summit
english: Negotiators at the COP31 climate summit are working to finalize a global agreement after talks went into overtime, with a new draft document recently introduced to resolve deep disagreements. While the text acknowledges that global efforts are currently failing to meet the 1.5C temperature goal, it lacks explicit language regarding the phase-out of fossil fuels and specific funding for climate adaptation. Leaders remain divided, and there is a significant risk that these record-breaking negotiations could be suspended until next year if a consensus is not reached.
amharic: የCOP31 የአየር ንብረት ጉባኤ ተሳታፊዎች ለረጅም ጊዜ ሲካሄድ የቆየውን ድርድር ለመቋጨት አዲስ ረቂቅ ስምምነት ይዘው ቀርበዋል። አዲሱ ረቂቅ ዓለም አቀፍ የአየር ንብረት ግቦችን ማሳካት እንዳልተቻለ ቢጠቅስም፣ የቅሪተ አካል ነዳጅ አጠቃቀምን ስለመቀነስ እና ለተግባራዊ ስራዎች የሚሆን የገንዘብ ድጋፍን በተመለከተ ግልጽ የሆነ መፍትሄ አላካተተም። ስምምነት ላይ ካልተደረሰ ድርድሩ እስከሚቀጥለው ዓመት ሊራዘም የሚችልበት ከፍተኛ ስጋት ስላለ፣ ተሳታፊ አገራት አቋማቸውን ለማቀራረብ ጥረት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Hirmaattonni walgahii jijjiirama qilleensa COP31 marii dheeraa booda waliigaltee addunyaa irra gahuuf yaalii gochaa jiru. Qophiin waliigaltee haaraan bahe kun addunyaan kaayyoo garmalee qabbaneessuu qilleensaa guutuu akka hin dandeenye kan ibsu yoo tahu, garuu fayyadama boba'aa fi maallaqa gargaarsaa ilaalchisee yaada ifa ta'e hin qabu. Yoo waliigaltee irra gahuu baatan mariin kun hanga waggaa dhufuutti dheerachuu waan danda'uuf, biyyoonni rakkoo jiru furuuf marii irra jiru.

title: Gukesh vs Sindarov: The youngest World Chess Championship in history
english: India’s Gukesh Dommaraju is set to defend his world chess title against Uzbekistan’s Javokhir Sindarov in Geneva, starting November 24. This match is historic as both competitors are only 20 years old, marking the youngest championship pairing ever. The winner will be determined over 14 games, with a total prize pool of $2.5 million at stake.
amharic: የህንዱ ጉኬሽ ዶማራጁ የዓለም የቼዝ ሻምፒዮንነት ክብሩን ከኡዝቤኪስታኑ ጃቮኪር ሲንዳሮቭ ጋር በጄኔቫ ይከላከላል። ጨዋታው ህዳር 14 ቀን የሚጀመር ሲሆን፣ ሁለቱም ተወዳዳሪዎች የ20 ዓመት ወጣቶች በመሆናቸው በታሪክ ትንሹ የዓለም ሻምፒዮና ውድድር ሆኗል። አሸናፊው እስከ 14 በሚደረጉ ጨዋታዎች የሚለይ ሲሆን፣ በአጠቃላይ 2.5 ሚሊዮን ዶላር የሽልማት ገንዘብ ተመድቧል።
oromo: Gukesh Dommaraju kan Hindii ta'e, qophii tapha shaampiyoonaa adunyaa irratti Javokhir Sindarov kan Uzbakkistaan ta'e waliin Jenevaa keessatti morkata. Taphattoonni lamaanuu waggaa 20 qofa waan ta'aniif, kun shaampiyoonaa adunyaa isa umriin isaanii isa xiqqaa ta'ee seenaa keessatti galmaa'eera. Shaampiyoonichi taphoota 14 keessatti kan murtaa'u yoo ta'u, badhaasni qarshii miliyoona 2.5 ta'u qophaa'eera.

title: Dashcam captures Russian missile strike on Lviv, Ukraine
english: A dashboard camera recently recorded the moment a Russian missile hit a residential area in Lviv, Ukraine, as part of a significant Friday offensive. The strike resulted in the deaths of two individuals and caused substantial damage to local infrastructure. This incident highlights the ongoing danger faced by civilians in western Ukraine during the conflict.
amharic: በዩክሬን ለቪቭ ከተማ ውስጥ አንድ የዳሽካም ካሜራ ሩሲያ በነዋሪዎች አካባቢ የፈጸመችውን የሚሳኤል ጥቃት ቀርጾታል። አርብ ዕለት በተፈጸመው በዚህ መጠነ ሰፊ ጥቃት ሁለት ሰዎች ህይወታቸውን ያጡ ሲሆን፣ የአካባቢው መሠረተ ልማቶችም ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በጦርነቱ ምክንያት በምዕራብ ዩክሬን የሚኖሩ ንፁሃን ዜጎች ለከፍተኛ አደጋ መጋለጣቸውን ያሳያል።
oromo: Kaameeraan konkolaataa keessaa tokko yeroo xiyyaanni misaa'elaa Ruusiyaan gara magaalaa Liiviiv, Yukreenitti darbatamee mana jireenyaa tokko rukute viidiyoodhaan qabachuu danda'eera. Haleellaa guddaa guyyaa Jimaataa raawwatame kanaan namoonni lama lubbuun darbaniru akkasumas miidhaan qabeenyaa fi bu'uuraalee misoomaa irra ga'eera. Gochi kun yeroo ammaa bakka waraanni itti jiru kana jiraattota naannichaa irratti balaan cimaan akka jiru agarsiisa.

title: Max Verstappen wins F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix for third time in four years
english: Max Verstappen secured his third Las Vegas Grand Prix victory in four years after an exceptionally chaotic race that featured 35 lead changes. Despite the intense back-and-forth battling, Verstappen managed to finish ahead of McLaren's Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri. This unpredictable event was described by the drivers as one of the most surreal and intense competitions in Formula One history.
amharic: ማክስ ቨርስታፔን በላስ ቬጋስ ግራንድ ፕሪክስ ውድድር ለሶስተኛ ጊዜ አሸናፊ ሆኗል። ውድድሩ 35 ጊዜ መሪው የተቀያየረበት እጅግ አወዛጋቢ እና አስደናቂ ነበር። ቨርስታፔን የላንድ ኖሪስን እና ኦስካር ፒያስትሪን በመቅደም ድሉን ሊቀዳጅ ችሏል። አሽከርካሪዎቹ የዘንድሮውን ውድድር በፎርሙላ ዋን ታሪክ ውስጥ እጅግ አስገራሚ እና ፈታኝ ከነበሩት ውድድሮች አንዱ እንደሆነ ገልጸውታል።
oromo: Maaks Verstaapeen dorgommii Las Veegas Graandi Priiks waggaa afur keessatti yeroo sadaffaaf injifateera. Dorgommichi bakka bu'iinsa dura buutuu 35 qabaachuudhaan kan baay'ee walxaxaa fi dinqisiisaa ture dha. Verstaapeen konkolaachistoota Maaklaaren Laandoo Noorisiifi Ooskaar Piyaastirii dursuun injifannoo argateera. Dorgommichi seenaa Foormuulaa Waanii keessatti dorgommiiwwan baay'ee nama ajaa'ibsiisan keessaa tokko ta'uu isaa konkolaachistoonni ibsaniiru.

title: Indonesia factory fire kills three, 36 missing
english: A major fire broke out at a candy factory in Indonesia's Banten province, resulting in at least three confirmed deaths and 36 people still missing. Emergency teams rescued 15 individuals, some of whom required hospitalization, while firefighters continue to battle the blaze inside the three-story facility. Authorities are currently investigating the cause of the disaster, which impacted a factory employing around 60 workers at the time of the incident.
amharic: በኢንዶኔዢያ ባንተን ግዛት በሚገኝ የከረሜላ ፋብሪካ በተነሳ ከባድ የእሳት አደጋ ቢያንስ ሶስት ሰዎች ሲሞቱ 36 ሰዎች ደግሞ የደረሱበት አልታወቀም። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች 15 ሰዎችን ማዳን የቻሉ ሲሆን የተወሰኑት ለህክምና ወደ ሆስፒታል ተወስደዋል። የእሳት አደጋ መከላከል ሰራተኞች በሶስት ፎቅ ህንፃው ውስጥ እየነደደ ያለውን እሳት ለመቆጣጠር ጥረት እያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ ባለስልጣናት የአደጋውን መንስኤ ለማወቅ ምርመራ መጀመራቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Indoneziyaa kuta biyya Baanten keessatti, faaktirii daa'immanii nyaatan tokko irratti ibidda ka'een lubbuun namoota sadii yoo darbu, namoonni 36 ammoo hanga ammaatti bakki bu'an hin beekamu. Gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa namoota 15 oolchuun kan danda'an yoo ta'u, isaan keessaa muraasni yaalamuu fi mana yaalaa akka geessaman ibsameera. Ibidni kun faaktirii guddina sadii qabu sana keessatti kan ka'e yoo ta'u, dhaamsiiftoonni ibiddaa boba'aa jiru dhaamsuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru; mootummaanis sababa ibidda kanaa qorachuu jalqabeera.

title: Wembanyama scores 50 points, bags 19 rebounds in Spurs’ 14th win of season
english: Victor Wembanyama delivered a dominant performance for the San Antonio Spurs, scoring 50 points and grabbing 19 rebounds in a victory over the New Orleans Pelicans. His impressive statistics, which included five blocks and four steals, made him only the third player in over 50 years to reach those specific milestones in a single game. This win brings the Spurs to a 14-3 record, currently tied for the best performance in the NBA this season.
amharic: ቪክቶር ዌምባንያማ ሳን አንቶኒዮ ስፐርስ በኒው ኦርሊንስ ፔሊካንስ ላይ ድል ሲቀዳጅ 50 ነጥብ በማስቆጠር እና 19 ጊዜ ኳስን በመቀማት አስደናቂ ብቃት አሳይቷል። በአንድ ጨዋታ 50 ነጥብ፣ 15 የኳስ ቅበላ፣ አራት መረከብ እና አምስት መከላከያዎችን በማድረግ በኤንቢኤ ታሪክ ከ50 ዓመታት በላይ ውስጥ ይህንን ቁጥር የደረሰ ሦስተኛው ተጫዋች ሆኗል። ይህ ድል የሳን አንቶኒዮ ስፐርስን የዘንድሮ ውጤት 14-3 በማድረስ ሊጉን ከሚመሩ ቡድኖች ጋር እንዲስተካከሉ አስችሏቸዋል።
oromo: Fiiktori Weembaanyaamaa guddina guddaa San Antooniyoo Spars, poyintii 50 galchuufi rebawundii 19 fudhachuun Niiwu Orliins Piliikaansiin injifateera. Gatiin inni galche kun, kan dabalatuu blokii shanifi saamsii afur, taphataa afurtama keessatti asii achi tahaa jiru kana keessatti seenaa ajaa'ibsiisaa hojjeteera. Injifannoon kun Spars rikordii 14-3 akka qabaatan kan godhe yommuu tahu, amma gita ykn qixxee taphattoota NBA jalqabaa ta'aniiru.

title: Aviation Regulator Scores High, Still Short of Inspectors
english: The Ethiopian Civil Aviation Authority recently received a strong 85.76 percent rating for its safety oversight in an audit conducted by the International Civil Aviation Organisation. Despite this positive outcome, the regulator faces a staffing shortage with only seven inspectors currently responsible for monitoring 146 aircraft. The agency had to make urgent adjustments during the evaluation process to address deficiencies within its flight operations department.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ሲቪል ኤቪዬሽን ባለሥልጣን በአለም አቀፍ የሲቪል አቪዬሽን ድርጅት በተደረገለት ኦዲት 85.76 በመቶ ውጤት በማምጣት አጥጋቢ አፈጻጸም አስመዝግቧል። ይሁን እንጂ ድርጅቱ በአሁኑ ወቅት 146 አውሮፕላኖችን የሚቆጣጠሩት ሰባት የበረራ ኦፕሬሽን ኢንስፔክተሮች ብቻ በመሆናቸው የሰው ኃይል እጥረት አለበት። በኦዲቱ ወቅት የታዩ የአሰራር ክፍተቶችን ለማስተካከል ባለሥልጣኑ የመጨረሻ ደቂቃ ማስተካከያዎችን ለማድረግ ተገዷል።
oromo: Abbaan Taayitaa Siivil Avuyeeshinii Itoophiyaa, dhaabbata Siivil Avuyeeshinii idil-addunyaatiin qorannoo taasifameefin qabxii gaarii 85.76 argateera. Ta'us, abbaan taayitichaa yeroo ammaa xiyyaarota 146 to'achuuf qorattoota balaliin 7 qofa waan qabuuf rakkoo hanqina hojjattootaa keessa jira. Qorannoo sana gidduutti, kutaa balaliin isaa irratti hanqina mul'ate furuuf tarkaanfiin ariifachiisaan fudhatameera.

title: Businesses Who Offered to Rebuild Mercato Demand a Seat at the Plan
english: Business owners whose shops in the Mercato area were demolished are calling for official inclusion in the site's redevelopment planning. These traders had previously pledged 180 million Birr to fund the reconstruction efforts themselves. Now, they are expressing deep concern over their financial stability, specifically regarding their ability to manage rent payments and school fees for their families.
amharic: በመርካቶ አካባቢ የንግድ ቤቶቻቸው የፈረሱባቸው ነጋዴዎች፣ በቦታው ላይ በሚደረገው የልማት እቅድ ውስጥ ተሳታፊ እንዲሆኑ እየጠየቁ ነው። እነዚህ ነጋዴዎች ቀደም ሲል ቦታውን በራሳቸው ወጪ ለመገንባት 180 ሚሊዮን ብር አቅርበው ነበር። በአሁኑ ወቅት የንግድ ቦታ መፍረሱን ተከትሎ የቤት ኪራይ እና የትምህርት ቤት ክፍያዎችን እንዴት እንደሚሸፍኑ በመጨነቅ ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Abbootiin qabeenyaa bakki daldalaa isaanii ganda Merkato keessatti diigame, karoora misoomaa naannichaa irratti hirmaachuu akka qaban gaafachaa jiru. Daldaltoonni kun kanaan dura iddoo sana ofiin ijaaruuf qarshii miiliyoona 180 dhiyeessanii turan. Amma garuu, hojiin daldalaa isaanii waan adda citeef, kiree manaafi kaffaltii barnoota ijoollee isaanii akkamitti akka raawwatan yaaddoo guddaa keessa galanii jiru.

title: Pakistan Brings Drug Registration Complaints into Ethiopia’s WTO Endgame
english: Ethiopia is continuing its long-standing efforts to join the World Trade Organization (WTO) as a way to secure its economic reforms. While these negotiations are ongoing, Pakistan has raised concerns regarding the registration process of pharmaceutical products in Ethiopia. Beyond the membership bid, Pakistan is also looking to strengthen bilateral cooperation in sectors like manufacturing, agriculture, and textiles.
amharic: ኢትዮጵያ የኢኮኖሚ ማሻሻያዎቿን አስተማማኝ ለማድረግ ለረጅም ዓመታት የጀመረችውን የዓለም የንግድ ድርጅት (WTO) አባልነት ሂደት እያከናወነች ትገኛለች። በዚህ ሂደት ውስጥ ፓኪስታን በኢትዮጵያ የሕክምና ውጤቶች ምዝገባ ላይ ያላትን ቅሬታ በውይይት ማዕቀፍ ውስጥ አንስታለች። ከዚህ የአባልነት ጥያቄ ባሻገር፣ ፓኪስታን በምርት፣ በግብርና እና በጨርቃጨርቅ ዘርፎች በኢትዮጵያ ጋር የሁለትዮሽ ትብብሯን ለማጠናከር ፍላጎት አላት።
oromo: Itoophiyaan jijjiirama dinagdee ishee mirkaneeffachuuf karra Dhaabbata Daldala Addunyaa (WTO) seenuuf yaalii waggoota dheeraa erga jalqabdee as itti fuftee jirti. Adeemsa kana keessatti, Paakistaan dhimma galmee qoricha farmaasii Itoophiyaa keessatti mul'atu irratti komii kaastee jirti. Itoophiyaan miseensa ta'uuf carraaqqii gootu cinaatti, Paakistaan dameewwan oomishaa, qonnaa fi uffataa irratti Itoophiyaa wajjin walta'iinsa gama lamaa cimsachuuf fedhii qabdi.

title: Court Clears Sandford’s Tuition of Tax, Appeal Looms
english: Federal judges have ruled that Sandford International School is not required to pay over 129 million Birr in taxes, declaring its tuition earnings exempt from profit tax. The court overturned a previous decision by the Federal Tax Appeal Commission, canceling all related penalties and interest from the past five years. Despite this ruling, the Ministry of Revenues intends to challenge the decision in a higher court.
amharic: የፌደራል ዳኞች ሳንድፎርድ ኢንተርናሽናል ትምህርት ቤት ከትምህርት ክፍያ የሚያገኘው ገቢ ከትርፍ ታክስ ነፃ መሆኑን በመወሰን፣ ተጥሎበት የነበረውን ከ129 ሚሊዮን ብር በላይ የግብር ውሳኔ ሰርዘዋል። ፍርድ ቤቱ ቀደም ሲል የፌደራል ግብር ይግባኝ ኮሚሽን የሰጠውን ውሳኔ በመሻር፣ ትምህርት ቤቱ ባለፉት አምስት ዓመታት የነበረበትን የግብር እዳ እና ቅጣት በሙሉ እንዲነሳለት ወስኗል። ሆኖም የገቢዎች ሚኒስቴር በዚህ ውሳኔ ላይ ይግባኝ ለመጠየቅ ማቀዱን አስታውቋል።
oromo: Abbootiin seeraa federaalaa mana barnootaa idil-addunyaa Sandford irratti kaffaltii gibiraa qarshii miiliyoona 129 ol ture haqaniiru. Manni maree seeraa kun galii mana barnootichaa kan argamu kaffaltii barnootarraa waan ta'eef, gibira bu'arraa bilisa akka ta'e murteesseera. Murtiin kun komishinii iyyannoo gibiraa federaalaatiin duraan kenname kan diige yoo ta'u, kaffaltiiwwan waggoota shan darbanitti turan hundi haqamaniiru; ta'us, Ministeerri Galiiwwanii murtii kana mormuun gara sadarkaa ol'aanaatti iyyachuuf qophaa'aa jira.

title: ShebaMiles Breach Tests Ethiopia’s 72-hour Data Rule
english: Hackers recently infiltrated Ethiopian Airlines' ShebaMiles program, compromising the personal data of over 5.38 million frequent flyer accounts. The airline identified the security breach on November 17, 2026, and confirmed that the situation is now under control. While investigations into the extent of the unauthorized access continue, there is currently no indication that any customer financial details were stolen.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ አየር መንገድ የሼባ ማይልስ መርሃ ግብር በጠላፊዎች ጥቃት የተፈጸመበት ሲሆን ከ5.38 ሚሊዮን በላይ የደንበኞች መረጃ ተጋልጧል። አየር መንገዱ ጥቃቱን ህዳር 8 ቀን 2019 ዓ.ም የደረሰበት ሲሆን በአሁኑ ወቅት ሁኔታው በቁጥጥር ስር መዋሉን ገልጿል። እስካሁን ባለው መረጃ መሰረት ምንም አይነት የገንዘብ ነክ መረጃዎች አለመሰረቃቸው የተረጋገጠ ሲሆን የጥቃቱን መጠን ለመለየት ምርመራ እየተካሄደ ነው።
oromo: Hakkaronni sagantaa ShebaMiles kan Qilleensa Itoophiyaa seenuun odeeffannoo maamiloota miiliyoona 5.38 ol ta'an miidhaniiru. Qilleensa Itoophiyaa qilleensichi akka miidhame Sadaasa 8, 2019 hubateera, ammas haalli kun to'annoo jala akka jiru beeksiseera. Odeeffannoon faayinaansii maamilootaa akka hin hatamne hanga yoonaatti kan mirkanaa'e yoo ta'u, hangam akka miidhame qorachuun itti fufee jira.

title: Moviegoers head for the exits as quake strikes Peru
english: A 6.7-magnitude earthquake struck Peru this past Friday, causing significant alarm among the public. Footage captured moviegoers quickly leaving a cinema while watching the latest Hunger Games film as the tremors began. No injuries were reported, but the sudden seismic activity disrupted public activities throughout the area.
amharic: ባለፈው አርብ በፔሩ የ6.7 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ተከስቷል። የሃንገር ጌምስ ፊልም ሲመለከቱ የነበሩ ተመልካቾች የመሬት መንቀጥቀጡ ሲጀምር በፍጥነት ከሲኒማ ቤቱ ሲወጡ የሚያሳይ ምስል ተሰራጭቷል። ምንም እንኳን ጉዳት የደረሰበት ሰው ባይኖርም ድንገተኛው የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ በከተማዋ የነበሩ እንቅስቃሴዎችን አቋርጦ ነበር።
oromo: Guyyaa Jimaata darbe biyya Peeruu keessatti sochiin lafaa humni isaa 6.7 ta'e tokko mudatee jira. Namoonni fiilmii 'Hunger Games' ilaalaa turan erga sochiin lafaa eegalee booda ariitiin mana fiilmiichaa keessaa ba'uun isaanii viidiyoodhaan waraabamee jira. Miidhaan qaamaa kan ga'e jiraachuu baatus, sochiin lafaa kun tasa mudate sun jireenya guyyaa guyyaa iddoo sanaa irratti dhiibbaa umee ture.

title: Clashes erupt across France in another night of protest
english: France experienced another weekend of widespread protests as citizens took to the streets for the sixth consecutive time. Demonstrators are voicing their frustration over rising living expenses and significant income inequality within the country. Authorities intervened using force to scatter the crowds during the latest wave of unrest.
amharic: ፈረንሳይ ለስድስተኛ ተከታታይ ሳምንት በሀገር አቀፍ ደረጃ የተካሄዱ የተቃውሞ ሰልፎችን አስተናግዳለች። ተቃዋሚዎቹ እየጨመረ የመጣውን የኑሮ ውድነት እና የገቢ ክፍፍል አለመመጣጠንን በመቃወም ድምጻቸውን እያሰሙ ነው። የሀገሪቱ የጸጥታ ሃይሎችም ሰልፈኞቹን ለመበተን ኃይል ተጠቅመዋል።
oromo: Faransaatti torbaan ja’affaa walitti aansuun mormiin bal’aan geggeeffamaa jira. Hiriirtonni kun baasii jireenyaa dabee fi qoodinsa galii wal-qixa hin taane mormuun yaada isaanii ibsachaa jiru. Poolisoonni biyyattis hiriirtota kana bittinneessuuf humna fayyadamaniiru.

title: Iran war live: Iran targets US bases in Bahrain; Houthi strikes continue
english: Iran's Revolutionary Guard has launched strikes against US radar systems located at airbases in Bahrain, prompting condemnation from the Bahraini government. Meanwhile, the Houthi movement continues to conduct military operations targeting Saudi Arabia, causing brief security alarms in the Mecca region. These events represent a significant escalation in regional tensions involving Iran and its allied groups.
amharic: የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ በባህሬን የሚገኙ የአሜሪካን የአየር መከላከያ ራዳር ስርዓቶች ላይ ጥቃት ፈጽሟል፤ የባህሬን መንግስትም ድርጊቱን በጽኑ አውግዟል። በተመሳሳይ መልኩ፣ በኢራን ድጋፍ የሚንቀሳቀሱት የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሳውዲ አረቢያ ላይ ጥቃታቸውን ቀጥለዋል፤ ይህም በመካ አካባቢ ለአጭር ጊዜ የደህንነት ስጋት ፈጥሯል። እነዚህ ክስተቶች በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ያለው የጸጥታ ሁኔታ እየተባባሰ መምጣቱን ያሳያሉ።
oromo: Humnoonni tiksaa naannoo warra Iran, buufataalee waraana Amerikaa kan Bahreyn keessa jiran irratti haleellaa raadiyoo kan raawwatan ta'uu gabaasameera; mootummaan Bahreynis tarkaanfii kana balaaleffateera. Gama biraatiin, gareen Houtii kan Iran irraa deggarsa argatu, haleellaa isaa biyya Saudi Arabiyaa irratti itti fufuun, magaalaa Makkaas naannawa sanatti sodaa nageenyaa uumee ture. Gochotni kun walitti bu'iinsa naannawa sanaa daran kan hammaate ta'uu agarsiisa.

title: Lebanese president demands Israel withdrawal, decries Iran’s interference
english: Lebanese President Joseph Aoun has called for the immediate withdrawal of Israeli forces from his country and strongly criticized Iran for interfering in Lebanon's internal affairs. During an Independence Day address, he vowed to consolidate all military power under the authority of the state to ensure no armed groups operate independently. While a prior agreement aimed for peace and the disarmament of groups like Hezbollah, these efforts remain stalled amid ongoing violence.
amharic: የሊባኖሱ ፕሬዚዳንት ጆሴፍ አውን የእስራኤል ኃይሎች ከሀገራቸው እንዲወጡ የጠየቁ ሲሆን ኢራን በሀገሪቱ የውስጥ ጉዳይ ላይ እያደረገች ያለውን ጣልቃ ገብነት አውግዘዋል። የሊባኖስን ነፃነት በተመለከተ ባደረጉት ንግግር፣ የሀገሪቱን ወታደራዊ ኃይል በሙሉ በመንግስት ቁጥጥር ስር ለማድረግ እንደሚሰሩ ቃል ገብተዋል። ምንም እንኳን ቀደም ሲል ለሰላም እና የሂዝቦላህን ትጥቅ ለመፍታት ስምምነት ቢደረግም፣ አሁን ባለው ግጭት ምክንያት ትግበራው ተስተጓጉሎ ይገኛል።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin Libaanoos Jooseef Aawun waraanni Israa'eel biyyattii gadi lakkisee akka bahuu fi Iran dhimma keessa biyya isaanii keessa galuun ishee akka dhaabdu gaafataniiru. Guyyaa walabummaa biyyattii ilaalchisee haasaa taasisaniin, meeshaalee waraanaa hunda to'annoo mootummaa jala oolchuuf akkasumas gareeleen hidhatan mootummaa ala akka hin sochoone mirkaneessuuf waadaa galaniiru. Kanaan dura nagaa buusuuf fi meeshaa waraanaa garee Hizbolaah hiiksisuuf waliigalteewwan godhaman kan jiran ta'us, waldhibdee ammaa kanaan walqabatee hojiin kun gufatee jira.

title: Iran faces a ‘silent economic war’, says Iranian president
english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has stated that the country is currently enduring a 'silent economic war.' He characterized this financial pressure as being more severe and challenging than traditional military warfare. The remarks highlight the significant strain the current economic situation is placing on the nation.
amharic: የኢራን ፕሬዝዳንት ማሱድ መዜሽኪያን አገራቸው በአሁኑ ሰዓት 'ዝምተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ጦርነት' ውስጥ እንዳለች ተናግረዋል። ይህንን የኢኮኖሚ ጫና ከመደበኛ የጦር ግጭት በላይ አስቸጋሪ እና ፈታኝ እንደሆነ ገልጸውታል። አስተያየታቸው በአሁኑ ወቅት በኢኮኖሚው ላይ የተደቀነው ችግር ለኢራን ትልቅ ፈተና እንደሆነ ያሳያል።
oromo: Pirezidaantii Iraan Maasuud Pezeeshkiyaan akka jedhanitti, biyyi isaanii yeroo ammaa 'waraana diinagdee cal'isuu' keessa jirti. Miidhaa diinagdee kana waraana waraanaa idilee caalaa baay'ee cimaa fi ulfaataa akka ta'e ibsaniiru. Yaanni kun rakkoon diinagdee yeroo ammaa biyyattii mudate hangam akka ulfaatu kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Russia-bound ship attacked in Gulf of Finland
english: A Russian cargo ship, the Sparta II, was damaged by a drone strike in the Gulf of Finland while traveling to Kaliningrad. The vessel caught fire and drifted into Finnish waters, prompting local authorities to impose temporary movement restrictions. While the ship's crew was eventually evacuated to another vessel, Finnish officials noted a potential airspace violation by a Russian helicopter during the response efforts.
amharic: ስፓርታ 2 የተሰኘ የሩሲያ ጭነት መርከብ ወደ ካሊኒንግራድ በመጓዝ ላይ እያለ በፊንላንድ ባህረ ሰላጤ በድሮን ጥቃት ደርሶበታል። መርከቧ በእሳት ተያይዛ ወደ ፊንላንድ የባህር ክልል በመንሳፈፏ የፊንላንድ ባለስልጣናት አካባቢውን ለጊዜው እንዲዘጋ አድርገዋል። የመርከቧ ሰራተኞች ወደ ሌላ መርከብ የተዛወሩ ሲሆን፣ በምላሽ እርምጃው ወቅት የሩሲያ ሄሊኮፕተር የፊንላንድን የአየር ክልል ጥሶ እንደነበር ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Markaan fe'umsaa Raashiyaa 'Sparta II' jedhamu tokko gara Kaaliniingiraadii utuu deemaa jiruu galaana Finlandiitti rukuttaa droonii irratti raawwatame. Markaan kun ibiddaan miidhamee gara daangaa bishaan Finlandiitti kan dhangala'e yoo ta'u, mootummaan Finlandiis daangaa sana irratti qajeelfama yeroo murteesseera. Hojjettoonni markichaa gara markaa biraatti kan jijjiiraman yoo ta'u, yeroo deebii kenname kanatti helikoptarri Raashiyaa tokko qilleensa Finlandii cabsee seenuun isaa gabaafameera.

title: Impunity fuels surge in settler violence across occupied West Bank
english: Violent attacks by Israeli settlers against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank are becoming more frequent. A recent incident involved the fatal shooting of a Palestinian man near Ramallah while he was attempting to access water. Reports indicate that these acts of aggression are escalating because perpetrators rarely face legal consequences for their actions.

oromo: Naannoo waldhabiinsa West Bank keessatti weerarri qotee bulaa Israa'elootaan Falasxiinota irratti raawwatamu dabalaa jira. title: Indian man jailed over plot to kill Sikh separatist in US
english: A man from India has been sentenced to over 19 years in a US prison for his role in a failed murder plot targeting a Sikh separatist leader. The operation aimed to assassinate Gurpatwant Singh Pannun while he was in the United States. Although the plot has caused significant international attention, the Indian government has officially denied any connection to the scheme.

Namni kun Gurpatwant Singh Pannun jedhaman, yeroo Ameerikaa turanitti ajjeesuuf karoorfate ture. Dhimmi kun xiyyeeffannaa addunyaa kan harkise ta'us, mootummaan Hindii shira kana keessatti hirmaannaa qabaachuu isaa guutummaatti haaleera.

title: Brazil’s Jair Bolsonaro in intensive care with bowel obstruction
english: Former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro has been admitted to an intensive care unit suffering from an acute bowel obstruction. While he is currently stable and breathing on his own, his son indicated that he may require another surgery to resolve the issue. Bolsonaro is currently serving a lengthy prison sentence for his involvement in a coup plot following his 2022 election defeat.
amharic: የብራዚል የቀድሞ ፕሬዝዳንት ጃየር ቦልሶናሮ በአንጀት መዘጋት ችግር ምክንያት በጽኑ ሕክምና ክፍል ውስጥ ገብተዋል። በህክምና ላይ የሚገኙት የቀድሞው ፕሬዝዳንት ሁኔታ በአሁኑ ሰዓት የተረጋጋ ቢሆንም፣ ልጃቸው ተጨማሪ ቀዶ ጥገና ሊያስፈልጋቸው እንደሚችል ገልጸዋል። ቦልሶናሮ የ2022ቱን ምርጫ ከተሸነፉ በኋላ መፈንቅለ መንግስት ለመሞከር በመሞከራቸው የ27 ዓመት እስራት በመቀጣት ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Pirezidaantii duraanii Biraazil Jair Bolsonaroon dhukkuba garaacha isaanii mudateen wal qabatee kutaa yaala hatattamaa keessatti yaalamaa jiru. Haalli fayyaa isaanii ammaaf tasgabbaa’aa ta’us, ilma isaanii akka ibsetti baqaqanii fiilachuu (opireeshinii) biroo isaan barbaachisuu danda’a. Bolsonaroon filannoo bara 2022 erga injifatanii booda yaaliin fonqolcha mootummaa taasisuu isaanii mirkanaa’ee waggaa 27 hidhamanii argamu.

title: Iran says held talks with Qatari mediators, urges US to accept conditions
english: Iranian officials recently met with Qatari mediators to explore potential diplomatic solutions to ongoing regional tensions. Iran insists that it will only consider reopening the strategic Strait of Hormuz if the United States lifts its economic sanctions, which Tehran views as an act of war. While discussions are currently informal, both sides remain divided over nuclear policy and economic blockade demands.

title: Thousands protest across Europe over living costs and housing
english: Massive protests have broken out across several European nations as citizens demand government action against high inflation, expensive housing, and insufficient public services. Demonstrations in France and Portugal follow earlier youth-led strikes across the continent, highlighting deep frustration among students and workers regarding their economic future. Participants are calling for better wages, more affordable living conditions, and improved support for essential social sectors.

title: Zelensky says Crimean Bridge strikes 'fair response' as he meets UK's Streeting
english: President Zelensky defended recent Ukrainian attacks on the Crimean Bridge, labeling them a justified reaction to Russian strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure. He countered claims that the bridge is for civilian use by pointing out its role in transporting Russian military equipment. During his meeting with the UK's Wes Streeting, Zelensky noted that ongoing Russian aggression signals Vladimir Putin's refusal to de-escalate the conflict.

oromo: Pirezidaantiin Yukireen Volodimiir Zelenski haleellaa isaanii kan biyya Raashiyaa fi Kiraymiiya wal quunnamsiisu irratti raawwatame, tarkaanfii seera qabeessa ta'e jechuun ibsan. title: Mexican drug lord on FBI's 10 most wanted list arrested in shoot-out
english: Mexican special forces have captured Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, a high-profile drug kingpin who appeared on the FBI's most-wanted list, following an intense armed confrontation in Sinaloa. Known for leading the Guasave Cartel and allegedly supplying massive amounts of dangerous narcotics to the United States, he was apprehended alongside his deputy. The United States is now pursuing his extradition to face multiple charges including drug trafficking, kidnapping, and torture.
amharic: የሜክሲኮ ልዩ ሃይል በኤፍቢአይ (FBI) የከፍተኛ ተፈላጊዎች ዝርዝር ውስጥ የነበረውን አደንዛዥ ዕፅ አዘዋዋሪ ፋውስተሮ ኢሲድሮ ሜዛ ፍሎሬስን በሲናሎአ በተደረገ የተኩስ ልውውጥ በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። የጓሳቬ ካርቴል መሪ የሆነው እና ለዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ከፍተኛ መጠን ያላቸው አደገኛ ዕጾችን በማቅረብ የሚከሰሰው ግለሰብ ከረዳቱ ጋር ተይዟል። አሜሪካ ተጠርጣሪውን ለፍርድ ለማቅረብ ወደ ሀገሯ የመውሰድ ጥያቄ እያቀረበች ትገኛለች።

Hogganaan Kaartel Guasave kun, qoricha sammuu namaa hadoochan hedduu gara Ameerikaatti guuraa ture jedhamee kan himatamu yoo ta'u, gargaaraa isaa waliin qabameera. Ameerikaan yakka gurgurtaa qoricha sammuu namaa, butii fi dararama namootaa irratti himatameef akka inni biyyatti dhiyaatu gaafachaa jirti.

title: Who is El Chapo Isidro, the alleged cartel boss arrested in Mexico?
english: Mexican special forces have captured Fausto Isidro Meza-Flores, a high-ranking cartel leader known as 'Chapo Isidro,' in the state of Sinaloa. Meza-Flores, who is unrelated to the infamous Joaquin Guzman, is one of the FBI's ten most wanted fugitives for his alleged role in flooding the United States with illegal drugs and committing violent crimes. His arrest follows increased pressure from the US government on Mexican authorities to take stronger action against powerful drug cartels.

title: US midterms 2026: What happens before the new Congress takes office?
english: Following the 2026 midterm elections, the Democrats have secured control of Congress, but they will not officially take power until January. During this transition period, the current Congress remains in a 'lame-duck' session, allowing outgoing members to continue legislative work while newly elected representatives prepare for their roles. Lawmakers are currently focused on selecting party leadership and attending orientation to ensure a smooth transition when the new session begins.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ. በ2026 በተካሄደው የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ዲሞክራቶች የኮንግረስ ቁጥጥርን ማሸነፋቸውን ተከትሎ፣ ስልጣናቸውን በይፋ የሚረከቡት በጥር ወር ይሆናል። በዚህ የሽግግር ወቅት፣ አሁን ያለው ኮንግረስ አሁንም ስራውን እየቀጠለ ሲሆን፣ አዲስ የተመረጡት ተወካዮችም ለኃላፊነታቸው እየተዘጋጁ ይገኛሉ። በዚህ ጊዜ ውስጥ የፓርቲ መሪዎችን የመምረጥ እና የኮንግረስ አሰራርን የመለማመድ ስራዎች በዋናነት እየተከናወኑ ነው።
oromo: Filannoo gidduu waggaa bara 2026 booda, paartiin Dimookraatawaa to’annaa Koongiresii kan argate yoo ta’u, aangoos kan fudhatan muddee dhufu kanatti. Yeroo cehumsaa kana keessa, koongiresiin amma jiru hojii isaa itti fufaa jira akkasumas miseensoonni haaraa filaman gara fuulduraatti gahee isaanii bahuuf qophii taasisaa jiru. Yeroo ammaa kana qaamni seera baastuun hogganoota paartii filachuu fi akkaataa hojii koongiresii barachuuf xiyyeeffannoo kennaa jiru.

title: French presidential candidate blames media for racist attack
english: French politician Jean-Luc Melenchon has publicly criticized the media for contributing to a violent racist attack that occurred in October. This incident resulted in the death of a 26-year-old Black man and left several others, including a child, injured. Melenchon suggests that the way television networks cover certain topics has played a role in escalating such harmful hostility.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ ፖለቲከኛ ዣን-ሉክ ሜለንቾን፣ በጥቅምት ወር የተፈፀመውን ዘረኛ ጥቃት በማባባስ የቴሌቪዥን ጣቢያዎችን ተጠያቂ አድርገዋል። በዚሁ ጥቃት አንድ የ26 ዓመት ወጣት ህይወቱ ሲያልፍ፣ አንድ ህፃን ልጅን ጨምሮ ሰባት ሰዎች ላይ ጉዳት ደርሷል። ሜለንቾን ሚዲያዎች ጉዳዮችን የሚያቀርቡበት መንገድ ለዚህ መሰል ጥላቻ መባባስ ምክንያት እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Poliitikaan Faransaayi Jean-Luc Melenchon, miidiyaaleen televisiyinii ajjeechaa sanyummaan kaka’ee ji'a Onkololeessa keessa raawwatamee fi nama gurraacha waggaa 26 ajjeese akkasumas ijoollee dabalatee namoota torba miidheef gumaachaniiru jechuun balaaleffataniiru. Melenchon akka jedhutti, gabaasni miidiyaaleen dhimmoota tokko tokko irratti godhan miira jibbaa akkasii hammaatee akka adeemu gochuuf gahee qaba.

title: Diallo present as Africa’s Motsepe reiterates support for FIFA’s Infantino
english: Patrice Motsepe, the head of the Confederation of African Football, has confirmed that all 54 African member nations will support Gianni Infantino’s re-election as FIFA president. This announcement was made during a meeting in Abuja where another presidential candidate, Philippe Diallo, was in attendance. Despite facing opposition from other international football bodies, Infantino continues to maintain strong backing from African and South American associations for his upcoming bid.
amharic: የአፍሪካ እግር ኳስ ኮንፌዴሬሽን ፕሬዝዳንት ፓትሪስ ሞትሴፔ፣ 54ቱ የአፍሪካ አገራት ለፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጂያኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ ዳግም መመረጥ ሙሉ ድጋፋቸውን እንደሚሰጡ አረጋግጠዋል። ይህ ይፋዊ መግለጫ የተሰጠው በሌላኛው ተወዳዳሪ ፊሊፕ ዲያሎ በተገኙበት በአቡጃ በተካሄደው ስብሰባ ላይ ነው። ኢንፋንቲኖ ከሌሎች የአህጉር እግር ኳስ አካላት ተቃውሞ ቢገጥመውም፣ የአፍሪካ እና የደቡብ አሜሪካ ኮንፌዴሬሽኖች ለቀጣይ የሥልጣን ዘመኑ ያላቸውን ጠንካራ ድጋፍ እንደቀጠሉበት ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Konfedereeshinii Kubbaa Miilaa Afrikaa Paatriis Mootseepee, biyyoonni Afrikaa 54 hundi isaanii pirezidaantii FIFA Jiyaanii Infaantiinoo deebii'anii filachuuf deeggarsa guutuu kennuuf murteessuu isaanii beeksisaniiru. Ibsi kun kan kenname yeroo dorgomaa biraa kan ta'an Filippi Dhiyaaloo argamanitti magaalaa Abujatti dha. Infaantiinoon gamtaa kubbaa miilaa biyyoota biraa irraa mormii mudatu illee, gamtaan Afrikaa fi Ameerikaa Kibbaa deeggarsa isaan isaaf qaban jabeessanii itti fufaniiru.

title: Tankers hit in Strait of Hormuz as Iran tightens grip on shipping
english: Two oil tankers were recently struck by unidentified projectiles near the Strait of Hormuz, causing no reported injuries. These attacks coincide with Iran's increased efforts to assert control over the strategic waterway by demanding that all vessels coordinate directly with its authorities. While Iranian officials claimed a tanker caught fire after hitting a naval mine due to non-compliance, international monitors are reporting a significant and dramatic rise in maritime incidents in the region.
amharic: በሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ አቅራቢያ ሁለት የነዳጅ ማመላለሻ መርከቦች ባልታወቁ ነገሮች ተመተው ጉዳት ደረሰባቸው፤ በሰው ላይ የደረሰ ጉዳት የለም። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የተከሰቱት ኢራን በስትራቴጂያዊው የባህር መስመር ላይ ቁጥጥሯን ለማጥበቅ በምትጥርበት ወቅት ሲሆን፣ ሁሉም መርከቦች ከእርሷ ጋር በቅንጅት እንዲሰሩ ትጠይቃለች። የኢራን የባህር ኃይል መርከቧ የባህር ላይ ፈንጂ የረገጠችው ህግን በመጣሷ ነው ቢልም፣ አለም አቀፍ ታዛቢዎች በክልሉ የባህር ላይ ግጭቶች በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እየጨመሩ መምጣታቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Hormuz keessatti markaboonni boba'aa lama kan miidhaman yoo ta'u, namni miidhame tokkollee hin jiru. Taateen kun kan uumame Iran daandii galaana kana to'achuuf yaali gootu keessaatti ta'ee, markaboonni hundi hayyama ishee akka gaafatan dirqisiisaa jirti. Mootummaan Iran markabichi kan gubate minee galaanaatti bu'ee ta'uu ishee ibsuus, qaamoleen idil-addunyaa miidhaan markaboota galaana irratti mudatu akka tasaa dabalaa jiraachuu himu.

title: After outages hit US banks and aviation, FBI database reported hacked
english: The FBI is currently investigating a cyberattack on its National Crime Information Center, a critical database used by law enforcement agencies across the United States. Officials are worried that hackers might have compromised the accuracy of sensitive criminal records, potentially endangering police operations. This breach follows a recent wave of major technological disruptions that recently impacted various US airlines, banks, and global digital services.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፌዴራል ምርመራ ቢሮ (FBI) በአገር አቀፍ ደረጃ ለፖሊስ አገልግሎት የሚውለው የወንጀል መረጃ ቋቱ በሳይበር ጥቃት መጎዳቱን ተከትሎ ምርመራ እየጀመረ ነው። ባለሙያዎች ጥቃቱ የወንጀል መረጃዎችን ትክክለኛነት ሊያዛባ ይችላል የሚል ስጋት አላቸው። ይህ ክስተት በቅርቡ በአሜሪካ የአየር መንገድ፣ የባንክ እና የቴክኖሎጂ ዘርፎች ላይ ከደረሱ ተከታታይ የቴክኒክ ችግሮች ጋር ተያይዞ የተከሰተ ነው።
oromo: FBI qorannoo deemsisaa kan jiru yoo ta'u, kuusaan ragaa yakkaa kan biyyoolessa (NCIC) jedhamu weerara saayibariin miidhameera. Ogeeyyonni akka jedhanitti, namoonni ragaa kana hatan odeeffannoo sirrii ta'e mancaasuun hojii poolisii irratti danqaa uumuu danda'u. Rakkoon kunis yeroo dhihoo asitti tajaajiloota qilleensa irraa, baankiiwwanii fi buuuraalee misooma teeknoolojii biyyattii irratti rakkoowwan quunnamtii mudatan waliin walqabata.

title: 'Will throw keys back to UN': Trump-appointed Board of Peace adviser says Israel blocking efforts
english: A senior adviser for the US-led Board of Peace has warned that the organization may hand its responsibilities back to the UN if Israel continues to impede the stabilization plan for Gaza. Josh Gruenbaum expressed frustration that the Israeli government is failing to honor commitments previously made by Prime Minister Netanyahu to President Trump regarding demilitarization and humanitarian efforts. The mission has remained stalled due to ongoing violence and disagreements over the disarmament of Hamas, despite its UN-backed mandate to rehabilitate the region.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የሰላም ቦርድ ከፍተኛ አማካሪ እስራኤል ለጋዛ የተዘጋጀውን የሰላም ዕቅድ ማደናቀፏን ከቀጠለች፣ ቦርዱ ኃላፊነቱን ለተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት እንደሚመልስ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ጆሽ ግሩንባም እንደተናገሩት ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ለፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የገቡትን ቃል ባለመጠበቃቸው የተፈጠረው መዘግየት እጅግ አሳሳቢ ነው። የጋዛን አካባቢ ለማረጋጋት እና የሐማስን ትጥቅ ለማስፈታት የታቀደው ይህ ተልዕኮ፣ በእስራኤል ቀጣይ ጥቃቶች እና በተፈጠሩ አለመግባባቶች ምክንያት ለወራት ሳይሳካ ቀርቷል።
oromo: Gorsaan olaanaan Boordii Nageenyaa kan US durfamu tokko, Israa'el karoora tasgabbii Gaazaaf qophaa'e gufachiisuu yoo itti fufte, boordichi itti gaafatamummaa isaa gara Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtooniitti akka deebisu akeekkachiiseera. Josh Gruenbaum akka jedhanitti, Ministirri Muummee Binyamin Netanyaahu duratti Pirezidaant Traampitti waadaa seenan hojii irra oolchuuf fedhii dhabuun isaanii baay'ee kan nama gaddisiisuudha. Tattaaffiin Gaazaa tasgabbeessuu fi meeshaa waraanaa Hamaas hiikkachiisuu karoora UN deggerame kana irratti hundaa'e, waraana fi wal-dhabdee jiruun erga dhaabbate baatiiwwan hedduu lakkoofsiiseera.

title: Trump claims he 'never cared' about regime change in Iran
english: In a recent interview, Donald Trump stated that he is not focused on overthrowing the Iranian government, despite his past involvement in removing other regimes. He emphasized that his primary goal is to establish a lasting international agreement that permanently prevents Iran from obtaining nuclear weapons. He intends to ensure this restriction remains in place regardless of who leads the United States in the future.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በቅርቡ በሰጡት ቃለ ምልልስ፣ ከዚህ ቀደም ሌሎች መንግስታትን ከስልጣን ለማውረድ ቢሳተፉም አሁን ግን የኢራንን መንግስት የመቀየር ፍላጎት እንደሌላቸው ተናግረዋል። ዋና ትኩረታቸው ኢራን የኒውክሌር መሳሪያ እንዳታገኝ የሚያግድ ዘላቂ ስምምነት መፍጠር እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። ይህ ስምምነት ወደፊት የሚመጡ የአሜሪካ ፕሬዚዳንቶች ሊቀይሩት የማይችሉት ቋሚ መፍትሄ እንዲሆን እንደሚሰሩበት አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Donald Trump gaafii fi deebii kanaan dura taasisaniin, duraan mootummoota biroo aangoo irraa kaasuuf carraaqqii godhanii kan turan ta'us, amma garuu mootummaa Iraan jijjiiruuf fedhii akka hin qabne ibsaniiru. Kaayyoon isaanii inni guddaan Iraan meeshaa niwukilaaraa akka hin arganne ittisuuf waliigaltee dhaabbataa ta'e tokko uumuu akka ta'e dubbataniiru. Waliigalteen kunis gara fuulduraatti pirezidaantii Ameerikaa eenyuun iyyuu yoo ta'e kan hin jijjiiramne akka ta'uuf itti hojjechaa akka jiran ibsaniiru.

title: US denies Iran hit F-16 fighter jet
english: The United States military has officially rejected claims by Iran that it successfully struck an American F-16 fighter jet near the Strait of Hormuz. U.S. Central Command stated that no such attack occurred and confirmed that all of their aircraft currently operating in the Middle East are secure. These reports from Iranian officials were dismissed by American authorities as completely false.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ አመራር ኢራን በአሜሪካ የጦር አውሮፕላን ላይ ጥቃት ሰንዝሬያለሁ በማለት ያቀረበችውን ክስ ውድቅ አድርጓል። የአሜሪካ ማዕከላዊ ዕዝ በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት አካባቢ ምንም አይነት ጥቃት እንዳልተፈጸመ ገልጾ፣ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ የሚገኙ ሁሉም የአሜሪካ አውሮፕላኖች ደህና እንደሆኑ አረጋግጧል። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ያቀረቡት መረጃ ከእውነት የራቀ መሆኑን የአሜሪካ ወገን አስታውቋል።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyya Ameerikaa himata Iraan xiyyaara waraana Ameerikaa tokko irra miidhaa ga’eera jettee dhiyeessite haaluun beekame. Ajajni giddugaleessa Ameerikaa naannoo handaara Hormuzitti haleellaan akkasii hin raawwatamne jedheera. Xiyyaarotni waraana Ameerikaa hundi naannoo baha giddugaleessatti argaman miidhaa tokko malee nagaan akka jiran ibsameera.

title: 'Will throw keys back to UN': Trump-appointed Board of Peace adviser says Israel blocking efforts
english: A senior official on the US-led Board of Peace has warned that the group will hand its responsibilities back to the United Nations if Israel continues to obstruct the implementation of the Gaza stabilization plan. Although Hamas agreed to the disarmament roadmap, the board states that Israeli officials are blocking key steps, such as training local police and allowing the deployment of international peacekeeping forces. The board is frustrated by the lack of progress and accuses certain members of the Netanyahu government of failing to honor previous commitments made to President Trump.
amharic: በአሜሪካ የሚመራው የሰላም ቦርድ ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣን እስራኤል የጋዛን የመረጋጋት እቅድ ተግባራዊ ለማድረግ የምታደርገውን እንቅፋት ካላቆመች ሃላፊነታቸውን ለተባበሩት መንግስታት እንደሚመልሱ አስታወቁ። ሃማስ የትጥቅ መፍቻ ስምምነቱን ቢቀበልም፣ እስራኤል የፖሊስ ሰራዊት ስልጠናን እና የአለም አቀፍ የሰላም አስከባሪ ሃይል እንዲሰማራ በመከልከሏ ስራው መቆሙን ቦርዱ ገልጿል። የቦርዱ አባላት በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ መንግስት ውስጥ ያሉ አንዳንድ አካላት ለፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የገቡትን ቃል በመጣሳቸው ከፍተኛ ብስጭት እንደተሰማቸው ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Boordii Nageenyaa kan Ameerikaan durfamu, Israa'el karoora tasgabbii Gaazaaf gufuu ta'uu yoo itti fufte, hojii kana guutummaatti dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomaniif akka deebisan akeekkachiisan. Hamaas karaa nagaa meeshaa hiikkachuu fudhatee kan jiru yoo ta'u, garuu Israa'el leenjii poolisii fi ergama nageenyaa idil-addunyaa akka hin dhufne dhorkuun ishee hojichi akka hin milkoofne taasiseera. Boordichi, qaamoleen mootummaa Netaaniyaahuu keessa jiran tokko tokko waadaa pirezidaant Traamp waliin galan akka hin eegne himuun, haala jiruuf gadda guddaa ibsaniiru.

title: The TPLF’s Setbacks Do Not Determine Tigray’s Political Future
english: The TPLF's recent losses are mainly the result of internal leadership failures and a disconnect from the people's deep desire for peace after years of war. Internal divisions, forced recruitment tactics, and a misunderstanding of both domestic and geopolitical dynamics weakened their position more than federal military power. The future of Tigray remains uncertain and will depend on how both the TPLF and the federal government reform their approaches to regain public trust.
amharic: የህወሓት የቅርብ ጊዜ ሽንፈቶች በዋናነት የመጡት በአመራር ክፍተት እና ለዓመታት ከዘለቀው ጦርነት በኋላ ህዝቡ ሰላምን ካለው ከፍተኛ ፍላጎት ጋር መራራቅ ነው። የውስጥ ክፍፍል፣ በግዴታ የተፈጸመ ምልመላ እና የፖለቲካ ተለዋዋጭነትን በአግባቡ አለመገንዘብ፣ ከፌዴራል መንግስት ወታደራዊ አቅም በበለጠ መልኩ ድርጅቱን አዳክመውታል። የትግራይ የወደፊት እጣ ፈንታ ምን እንደሚሆን ገና ያልተወሰነ ሲሆን፣ ይህም በሁለቱም ወገኖች የሕዝብ አመኔታን ለመመለስ በሚያደርጉት የሪፎርም ሥራ ላይ የተመሰረተ ነው።
oromo: Injifannoon TPLF amma mudate inni gurguddoon dogoggora gaggeessummaa fi fedhii nagaa ummanni waraana waggoota hedduu booda qabu waliin wal-dhabuu irraa kan maddeedha. Rakkoowwan keessoo, dirqamaan loltoota ramaduu, akkasumas haala siyaasaa biyyattii fi naannichaa sirritti hubachuu dhabuun, humna waraana mootummaa federaalaatiin olitti akka isaan laaffatan taasiseera. Fuulduratti Tigraay maal akka taatu murtaa'aa miti; kunis mootummaan federaalaas ta'e TPLF amantii ummataa deeffachuuf jijjiirama akkamii akka godhan irratti kan hundaa'u ta'a.

title: Zelensky says Putin is a 'killer' after Trump calls Russian leader a friend
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has publicly labeled Vladimir Putin a killer in response to Donald Trump describing the Russian leader as a friend. Zelensky argued that characterizing Putin in a friendly manner undermines international pressure against him while Russia continues its deadly military strikes across Ukraine. Meanwhile, intense Russian missile and drone attacks have caused numerous casualties and widespread damage to Ukrainian infrastructure.
amharic: የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ፣ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሩሲያው መሪ ቭላዲሚር ፑቲንን ወዳጄ ብለው በመጥራታቸው ተቃውሟቸውን ገልጸው ፑቲን ገዳይ ናቸው ሲሉ ወቅሰዋል። ዘለንስኪ እንደሚሉት ፑቲንን እንደ ወዳጅ መግለጽ በሩሲያ ላይ የሚደረገውን አለም አቀፍ ጫና የሚያዳክም ነው። ይህ በእንዲህ እንዳለ፣ በዩክሬን ከተሞች ላይ እየደረሰ ያለው የሩሲያ የከባድ መሳሪያ እና የድሮን ጥቃት በርካታ ሰዎችን እየገደለ እና መሰረተ ልማቶችን እያወደመ ይገኛል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Yukreen Volodimir Zeleniskin, Donald Traamp gaggeessaa Raashiyaa Vladimir Puutiin 'hiriyoota koo' jechuun waamuun isaanii akka isa aarse ibsan. Zeleniskin akka jedhanitti, Puutiin hiriyaa utuu hin taane ajjeisaa akka ta'an fi isaan waliin haasa'uun dhiibbaa idil-addunyaa irratti godhamu kan hir'isu dha jedhan. Gama biraatiin, haleellaan misaayilaa fi doonii Raashiyaan magaaloottan Yukreen irratti gaggeessaa jirtu lubbuu namoota hedduu galaafachaa fi bu'uuraalee misoomaa barbadeessaa jira.

title: Deal with EU not dependent on tuition fees agreement, Miliband says
english: UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband has confirmed that a new trade and cooperation deal with the European Union will proceed regardless of unresolved negotiations over tuition fees for EU students. The agreement includes provisions for reduced food export checks, a youth mobility scheme, and closer energy cooperation. While leaders remain hopeful about reaching a separate understanding on university costs, officials emphasized that these core measures will be implemented as planned.
amharic: የእንግሊዝ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ኤድ ሚሊባንድ ከአውሮፓ ህብረት ጋር የተደረገው አዲስ የንግድ እና የትብብር ስምምነት፣ በአውሮፓ ህብረት ተማሪዎች የትምህርት ክፍያ ላይ መግባባት ባይደረስም ተግባራዊ እንደሚሆን አረጋግጠዋል። ስምምነቱ የምግብ ምርቶች ወደ ውጭ በሚላኩበት ጊዜ የሚደረጉ ቁጥጥሮችን መቀነስ፣ የወጣቶች የመንቀሳቀስ መርሃ ግብር እና የኢነርጂ ትብብርን ያካትታል። የመንግስት መሪዎች በትምህርት ክፍያ ጉዳይ ላይ ወደፊት መፍትሄ እንደሚገኝ ተስፋ ቢኖራቸውም፣ ዋና ዋናዎቹ የስምምነት ነጥቦች ግን በታቀደው መሰረት እንደሚተገበሩ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Ministeerri Dhimmi Alaa UK Ed Miliband akka ibsanitti, walii galteen haaraan gamtaa Awurooppaa waliin mallatteeffame barattoota gamtichaa irratti kan xiyyeeffatu kaffaltii barnootaa irratti walii galtee kan hin qabne ta'us kan hojiirra oolu ta'uu mirkaneessaniiru. Walii galteen kun meeshaalee nyaataa erguu irratti qorannoo hir'isuu, sagantaa sochiin dargaggootaa akka salphatu gochuu fi walitti dhufeenya anniisaa cimsuu dabalata. Hogganoonni kaffaltii barnootaa irratti fuuldura furmaata argachuuf abdii kan qaban ta'us, qabxiileen ijoon walii galtee kanaa akka karoorfametti hojiirra akka oolan ibsameera.

title: Fight over fossil fuels leaves COP31 climate talks in deadlock
english: Climate negotiations at the COP31 summit in Turkey have stalled due to deep disagreements over fossil fuels. A coalition of nations, including several European countries and Panama, is demanding that the final agreement explicitly address the need to move away from oil, gas, and coal. Additionally, African nations are pushing for increased financial support for climate adaptation, while the summit faces the grim reality that global temperature rise goals have already been exceeded.
amharic: በቱርክ በተካሄደው የCOP31 የአየር ንብረት ጉባኤ ላይ በቅሪተ አካል ነዳጆች ዙሪያ በተፈጠረ አለመግባባት ድርድሩ መቋጫ አጥቷል። እንደ ፈረንሳይ፣ ፓናማ እና ሌሎች የአውሮፓ ሀገራት ያሉ ቡድኖች የመጨረሻው ስምምነት የነዳጅ እና የድንጋይ ከሰል አጠቃቀምን ለመቀነስ ግልጽ ቁርጠኝነትን እንዲያካትት እየወተወቱ ነው። በሌላ በኩል የአፍሪካ ሀገራት ለአየር ንብረት መላመድ ተጨማሪ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ እየጠየቁ ሲሆን፣ ጉባኤው የዓለም ሙቀት መጨመር ግቡን መሳካቱን የይፋ ማድረጉ አሳሳቢ ሁኔታ ተፈጥሯል።
oromo: Gubaa COP31 kan Turkeetti gaggeeffamaa jiru, dhimma boba'aa lafa keessaa irratti walii galtee dhabuun isaa mariin sun akka dhaabbatu godheera. Biyyoonni Awurooppaa fi Panama dabalatee gartuun tokko, waliigalteen dhumaa fayyadama boba'aa fi carkii (coal) hir'isuuf akka kaayyuu qabaatu jabeessanii gaafachaa jiru. Gamtaan biyyoota Afrikaas deeggarsa maallaqaa gara fuulduraa dabaluuf gaafachaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, waliigalteen kun rakkoo ho'ina lafaa 1.5C ol dabre keessatti akka hin milkoofneef yaaddoo uumeera.

title: Can mediation succeed in a war-torn world? | Episode 1
english: The world is currently facing a record number of armed conflicts, reaching levels not seen since the Second World War. Mediators are finding it increasingly difficult to broker peace due to complex global alliances, proxy wars, and a decline in public trust. This series explores the significant obstacles that modern negotiators face when trying to bring opposing parties to the table.
amharic: ዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃው ከሁለተኛው የዓለም ጦርነት ወዲህ ታይቶ በማይታወቅ ሁኔታ ብዙ የጦር ግጭቶች እያስተናገደች ነው። ውስብስብ የሆኑ የኃያላን አገራት አሰላለፎች፣ በተዘዋዋሪ የሚካሄዱ ጦርነቶች እና የሕዝብ አመኔታ መቀነስ የሰላም ድርድርን እጅግ ፈታኝ አድርገውታል። ይህ ዘጋቢ ፕሮግራም ድርድር አቅራቢዎች ጠላቶችን ወደ ሰላም ጠረጴዛ ለማምጣት በዘመናችን የሚገጥሟቸውን ከባድ መሰናክሎች ይመረምራል።
oromo: Addunyaan yeroo ammaa kana kanneen Waraana Addunyaa lammaffaa booda mul'atan irra caalaa lakkoofsaan baay'ataa dhufan walitti bu'iinsa hidhattootaa hedduu keessummeessaa jirti. Walitti dhufeenyi biyyoota gurguddoo, waraanni bakka bu'ootaan gaggeeffamu fi amanamummaan ummataa hir'achuun isaa marii nagaa buusuu baay'ee ulfaataa taasiseera. Sagantaan kun, gareewwan wal diina ta'an marii nagaatiif walitti fiduuf giddudureewwan (mediators) yeroo ammaa kana dhibdee isaan mudatu irratti xiyyeeffata.

title: At least four killed, 35 injured in fire at power station in Iraq’s Basra
english: A major fire at the Hartha power station in Basra, Iraq, has resulted in at least four deaths and 35 injuries. The blaze, which spread to nearby residential homes, caused a complete halt to the plant's 800-megawatt operations. Authorities have managed to extinguish the fire, but the cause of the incident remains under investigation as the country continues to face challenges with aging electrical infrastructure.
amharic: በኢራቅ ባስራ ከተማ በሚገኘው የሃርታ የኤሌክትሪክ ማመንጫ ጣቢያ በተነሳ የእሳት አደጋ ቢያንስ አራት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ 35 ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። እሳቱ ወደ አቅራቢያው ወደሚገኙ መኖሪያ ቤቶች በመዛመቱ የጣቢያው የኤሌክትሪክ ማመንጫ ስራ እንዲቆም ተደርጓል። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች እሳቱን መቆጣጠር ቢችሉም፣ የችግሩ መንስኤ እስካሁን አልታወቀም።
oromo: Buufata anniisaa ibsaa Hartha kan magaalaa Basra, Iraaq keessatti ibiddii ga’een namoonni murni afur lubbuun isaanii darbee 35 ammoo miidhamaniiru. Ibidni kun gara manneen jireenyaa ollaa jiranitti babal'achuun hojiin buufata anniisaa kanaa akka dhaabbatu godheera. Hojjettoonni gargaarsa ariifachiisaa ibidicha to’achuu kan danda’an yoo ta’u, sababni balaa kanaa hamma ammaa hin beekamu.

title: Emergency crews in Ukraine hit by a double-tap strike
english: Russian forces carried out a deadly double-tap attack in Kryvyi Rih, Ukraine, where a second strike targeted emergency responders arriving at the scene of an initial bombing. This tactic resulted in the tragic deaths of a seven-year-old child and a 20-year-old rescue worker. Ukrainian officials highlighted the incident as a deliberate assault on those providing life-saving assistance.
amharic: የሩሲያ ኃይሎች በዩክሬን ክሪቪ ሪህ ከተማ ባደረሱት ድርብ ጥቃት የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞችን ኢላማ አድርገዋል። የመጀመሪያው ጥቃት በተፈጸመበት ቦታ እርዳታ ለመስጠት የደረሱ አዳኞች በሁለተኛው ቦምብ በመመታታቸው የአንድ የሰባት ዓመት ህጻን እና የ20 ዓመት ወጣት የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኛ ህይወት አልፏል። የዩክሬን ባለስልጣናት ይህ ድርጊት አዳኞችን ሆን ብሎ ለማጥቃት የታቀደ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni Raashiyaa magaalaa Kiriivii Rii, Yuukreen keessatti haleellaa yeroo lama walitti aansuun raawwataniin namoota gargaarsaaf dhaqqaban miidhaniiru. Haleellaa jalqabaa booda gargaarsaaf kan dhufan ogeeyyiin fayyaa fi namoonni biraa haleellaa lammaffaan waan rukutamaniif, ijoollee waggaa torba fi ogeessa gargaarsa namoomaa waggaa 20 ta'e tokko galaafatameera. Aangeyyoonni Yuukreen haleellaan kun namoota lubbuu baraaruuf yaalan irratti yaadamee kan raawwatame ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Three US citizens among 4 convicted in Honduras over sex-trafficking case
english: A Honduran court has convicted four individuals, including three Americans, for their involvement in a criminal network that recruited women for sex trafficking. The group, known as the Delta Teams, was linked to the 2022 disappearance of Angie Pena, a student who vanished while on a jet ski. While the defendants were found guilty of criminal association and face up to 10 years in prison, the court acquitted two of the American citizens of direct human trafficking charges due to lack of evidence.
amharic: የሆንዱራስ ፍርድ ቤት ሶስት አሜሪካውያንን ጨምሮ አራት ግለሰቦችን በሴቶች የሰዎች ዝውውር ወንጀል ተሳታፊ በመሆናቸው ጥፋተኛ ብሏቸዋል። እነዚህ ተከሳሾች በ2022 ዓ.ም በካሪቢያን ባህር የጠፋችውን አንጂ ፔና የተባለች ተማሪ ጉዳይ ጋር በተያያዘ የተቋቋመውን 'ዴልታ ቲምስ' የተባለ ህገ-ወጥ ቡድን አባላት ናቸው። ተከሳሾቹ በወንጀል ቡድን ውስጥ በመሳተፍ እስከ 10 ዓመት እስራት ሊቀጡ የሚችሉ ሲሆን፣ ፍርድ ቤቱ ግን በቂ ማስረጃ ባለመኖሩ ለሁለቱ አሜሪካውያን የሰዎች ዝውውር ክስ መከላከል መቻላቸውን ገልጿል።
oromo: Mana murtii Honduraas lammiilee Ameerikaa sadii dabalatee namoota afur irratti yakka shiftoo fi dubartoota gurgurachuu (human trafficking) irratti himannaan irratti mirkanaa'eera. Gareen 'Delta Teams' jedhamu kun bara 2022 barattuu Angie Pena jedhamtu erga baddee booda qorannoo irratti godhameen kan qabamanidha. Himatamaan kunneen yakka walta'iinsa shiftootin waggaa 10 takka hidhamuu kan danda'an ta'us, ragaan gahaa waan hin jirreef namoota Ameerikaa lama irraa himannaan gurgurachuu sun kaafameera.

title: Train collides with minibus in Indonesia
english: A passenger train struck a minibus at a railway crossing in North Sumatra, Indonesia, causing the vehicle to catch fire. Three crew members sustained injuries during the incident and required medical attention. The accident resulted in a temporary suspension of rail operations in the area.
amharic: በኢንዶኔዢያ ሰሜናዊ ሱማትራ የባቡር ሀዲድ መሻገሪያ ላይ የባቡር እና የሚኒባስ ተሽከርካሪ ግጭት ተከስቷል። በግጭቱ ምክንያት ሚኒባሱ በእሳት የተያያዘ ሲሆን ሶስት የባቡር ሰራተኞች ላይ ጉዳት ደርሶ ወደ ሆስፒታል ተወስደዋል። አደጋው በክልሉ የባቡር ትራንስፖርት አገልግሎት ላይ ለጊዜው መስተጓጎል ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Indooneziyaa, Sumaatraa kaabaatti baaburri tokko minibaasii waliin daandii qaxxaamuraa irratti walitti bu’uun balaa ibiddaa qaqqabsiiseera. Balaa kanaan hojjettoonni baaburaa sadan miidhamanii gara hospitaalaatti ergamaniiru. Gochi kun daandii baaburaa irratti tajaajilli akka adda citu godheera.

title: UK, France and China vote against UAE's Lana Nusseibeh at UN
english: UAE diplomat Lana Nusseibeh faced a significant hurdle in her campaign for UN Secretary-General after receiving discouraging votes from the UK, France, and China in a recent straw poll. Although she maintains support from the US and Russia, the opposition from these permanent Security Council members keeps her from reaching the required consensus. Despite the setback and criticism regarding her country's alleged involvement in the conflict in Sudan, Nusseibeh has stated she will continue her candidacy.
amharic: የተባበሩት አረብ ኤሚሬቶች ዲፕሎማት ላና ኑሰይቤህ ለተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ዋና ፀሐፊነት በሚያደርጉት ጥረት፣ በቅርቡ በተካሄደው የድምጽ መስጫ ሂደት ከዩናይትድ ኪንግደም፣ ከፈረንሳይ እና ከቻይና ተቃውሞ ገጥሟቸዋል። ምንም እንኳን አሜሪካ እና ሩሲያ ድጋፋቸውን ቢሰጧቸውም፣ የተባበሩት መንግስታት የጸጥታው ምክር ቤት ቋሚ አባላት ተቃውሞ ስራውን ለማግኘት አስቸጋሪ አድርጎባቸዋል። ኑሰይቤህ በአገራቸው ላይ በሱዳን ጦርነት ተሳትፎ ጋር በተያያዘ የሚነሱ ትችቶች ቢኖሩም፣ እጩነታቸውን እንደማይተው አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Diplomaatin biyya UAE Lana Nusseibeh, aangoo barreessaa olaanaa tokkummaa mootummootaaf godha turan irratti gufuun guddaan isaan mudateera. biyyootni akka UK, Faransaay fi Chaayinaan sagalee isaanii ishee mormuudhaan kennaniiru. Amerikaa fi Raashiyaan ishee deggerus, miseensota dhaabbata gorsaa nageenyaa kana biraa mormiin mudachuu isaatiin carraan ishee shakkiif saaxilameera. Nusseibeh waraana Sudaan keessatti biyyi ishee hirmaatteetti kan jedhu himannaa guddaa darbuus, falmii ishee itti fufuuf murteessiteetti.

title: Pro-Palestine donor James Chambers released, says 'my sacrifice is very small'
english: Spanish authorities have released US media heir James Cox Chambers Jr. on conditional bail while they review a request for his extradition. His release follows the discovery of significant translation errors in the FBI documents submitted by the US to justify his detention. Chambers, who denies the criminal charges against him, stated that his time in jail is minor compared to the ongoing struggle for Palestinian liberation.
amharic: የስፔን ከፍተኛ ፍርድ ቤት የአሜሪካው ሚዲያ ባለቤት የሆኑትን ጄምስ ኮክ ቻምበርስን ከአሜሪካ የቀረበባቸውን የኤክስትራዲሽን ጥያቄ በመመርመር ላይ እንዳሉ በዋስ ለቀቃቸዋል። ፍርድ ቤቱ ይህን ውሳኔ ያሳለፈው አሜሪካ በኤፍቢአይ ሰነዶች ላይ ትልቅ የትርጉም ስህተት እንደነበር አምነን ከተቀበለች በኋላ ነው። ቻምበርስ የቀረበባቸውን ክስ ውድቅ ያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ በእስር ያሳለፉት ጊዜ ለፍልስጤም ነፃነት ከሚደረገው ትግል አንፃር ሲታይ እዚህ ግባ የሚባል አለመሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa Ispeen, dhaaltuu miidiyaa Ameerikaa kan ta'an Jeemsi Koks Chaambers ilaalchisee gaaffii Ameerikaan isaan gadi dhiisisiisuuf dhiyeessite qorachaa osoo jiruun, qabxiiwwan tokko tokkoo guutuudhaan gadi isaan dhiiseera. Gadi dhiifamuun isaanii kan dhufef, ragaalee FBI Ameerikaan dhiyeessite keessatti dogoggorri hiikkaa afaanii guddaan akka ture beekamuu isaa hordofee dha. Chaambers yakka itti dhiyaate kan ganan yoo ta'u, hidhaan isaanii qabsoo bilisummaa Falasxiin waliin yoo madaalamu baay'ee xiqqoo ta'uu dubbataniiru.

title: Morning update
english: Tensions in the Middle East have escalated following renewed violence in Gaza, the West Bank, and Yemen, alongside drone activity near the Strait of Hormuz. Iran expressed a desire for diplomatic solutions with the US even as an American drone was reportedly downed in regional waters. Meanwhile, US officials are addressing the International Criminal Court and regional peace efforts, while Saudi forces continue to intercept incoming Houthi attacks.
amharic: በጋዛ፣ በምዕራብ ባንክ እና በየመን በተቀሰቀሰው አዲስ ግጭት እንዲሁም በሆርሙዝ የባህር ዳርቻ አቅራቢያ በተከሰተው የድሮን እንቅስቃሴ ምክንያት በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ያለው ውጥረት አድጓል። ኢራን ከአሜሪካ ጋር በዲፕሎማሲ ለመነጋገር ፍላጎት እንዳላት ብትገልጽም፣ የአሜሪካ ድሮን ተመትቶ እንደወደቀ ተዘግቧል። በሌላ በኩል የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት በአለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት እና በክልሉ የሰላም ጥረቶች ዙሪያ እየተወያዩ ሲሆን፣ የሳዑዲ ኃይሎችም በሁቲዎች የሚሰነዘሩ ጥቃቶችን እየከለከሉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Gidd Galeessa Bahaa keessatti walitti bu'iinsi Gaza, West Bank fi Yaman keessatti uumame akkasumas naannoo Hormuzitti sochii dooniiwwan malee (drones) dabaluun wal dhabdee naannichaa hammaateera. Iran Ameerikaa wajjin mariidhaan furmaata barbaaduu ibsituus, dooniin Ameerikaa tokko naannicha keessatti rukutamee kufuun gabaafameera. Gama biraatiin, aanga'oonni Ameerikaa Manni Murtii Yakkaa Addunyaa fi carraaqqii nagaa naannichaa irratti kan mari'atan yoo ta'u, humnoonni Sa'udii haleellaa Hutiin isaan irratti banan ittisuu itti fufaniiru.

title: Fire at Iraqi power station leaves four dead, 30 injured
english: A major fire at the Hartha power station in southern Iraq resulted in at least four deaths and 30 injuries. Emergency crews managed to contain the blaze, which also damaged nearby residential homes and caused the facility to shut down. Officials are still investigating the cause of the incident and the full scale of the destruction.
amharic: በደቡባዊ ኢራቅ በሚገኘው የሃርታ የኤሌክትሪክ ማመንጫ ጣቢያ በተነሳ የእሳት አደጋ ቢያንስ አራት ሰዎች ሲሞቱ 30 ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። የእሳት አደጋ መከላከል ቡድኖች እሳቱን መቆጣጠር ቢችሉም፣ አደጋው በአቅራቢያው በሚገኙ መኖሪያ ቤቶች ላይ ጉዳት በማድረሱ የጣቢያው ስራ እንዲቆም ተደርጓል። ባለስልጣናት የእሳቱን መንስኤ እና የደረሰውን አጠቃላይ ጉዳት ለማጣራት ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Buufata anniisaa elektirikii Hartha kan kibba Iraaq keessatti argamuutti ibiddi ka'een namoonni afur du'anii 30 immoo madaa'aniiru. Gareen balaa ittisuu ibidda sana to'achuun isaa kan himame yoo ta'u, ibiddichi manneen jireenyaa ollaa jiranis miidhee buufatichi akka dhaabbatu taasiseera. Qaamoleen mootummaa sababa ibidda kanaa fi miidhaa waliigalaa gahuu isaa irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: Seven Gazans wounded, one critically, in Israeli gunfire and airstrikes
english: Seven Palestinians were injured, one critically, following Israeli military operations in Gaza on Saturday. The attacks included shootings at displacement camps in Jabalia and Khan Younis, as well as an airstrike in the southern part of the territory. These incidents add to the high number of casualties reported in the region since the conflict intensified last October.
amharic: ቅዳሜ ዕለት በጋዛ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ጥቃት ሰባት ፍልስጤማውያን ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሲሆን የአንዱ ሁኔታ አሳሳቢ ነው። ጥቃቶቹ በጃባሊያ እና በካን ዩኒስ በሚገኙ ተፈናቃዮች መጠለያዎች ላይ የተፈጸሙ የተኩስ ልውውጦችን እና የአየር ድብደባን ያካትታሉ። እነዚህ ኩነቶች ካለፈው ዓመት ጥቅምት ወር ጀምሮ በክልሉ በግጭቱ ምክንያት ህይወታቸውን ያጡ እና ጉዳት የደረሰባቸውን ሰዎች ቁጥር ከፍ አድርገውታል።
oromo: Dilbata darbe weerara waraana Israa'el gaanfa Gaazaatti gaggeessineen namoonni Falasxiin torba miidhaniiru; isaan keessaa tokko haalli isaa cimaadha. Miidhaan kun kan ga'e bakkeewwan buqqaatonni keessa jiraatan Jabaliyaa fi Khaan Yuunisitti dhukaasaa fi haleellaa qilleensaan kan raawwatamedha. Haleellaan kun walitti bu'iinsa ji'a Onkoloolessa darbe kaasee biyyattii keessatti adeemaa jiruun namoota miidhaman baay'ina isaa irra kan dabaluudha.

title: French police officers sentenced for beating of music producer Michel Zecler
english: A French court has sentenced three police officers to prison for the 2020 beating of music producer Michel Zecler in his studio. The officers were found guilty of using excessive force and lying in a police report, which was disproven by CCTV footage. The court also identified a racial motive in the attack, leading to stricter sentences and a permanent ban from serving in the police force.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ ፍርድ ቤት እ.ኤ.አ በ2020 የሙዚቃ አዘጋጁን ሚሼል ዘክለር በስቱዲዮው ውስጥ በመደብደባቸው ሶስት የፖሊስ መኮንኖች ላይ እስራት ፈርዶባቸዋል። መኮንኖቹ ከመጠን ያለፈ ጥቃት በመፈጸማቸው እና በሲሲቲቪ ካሜራ በተቀረጸው ማስረጃ የተረጋገጠ የውሸት ሪፖርት በማቅረባቸው ጥፋተኛ ሆነው ተገኝተዋል። ፍርድ ቤቱ ጥቃቱ በዘረኝነት ላይ የተመሰረተ መሆኑን በማረጋገጡ፣ ተከሳሾቹ ከባድ ቅጣት የተጣለባቸው ሲሆን ከፖሊስነት ስራቸውም ለዘላለም ተባረዋል።
oromo: Mana murtii Faransaayitti poolisoonni sadan bara 2020 oomisha muuziqaa Mishel Zeikler jedhamu istudiyoo isaa keessatti reebanii miidhuun isaaniif adabbii hidhaa irratti murameera. Poolisoonni kunneen humna darbe fayyadamuu fi gabaasa sobaa barreessuu isaaniitiin yakkaamanii kan argaman yoo ta'u, gochi isaanii qabxiin kaameeraa CCTV irratti dhugoomera. Mana murtichaa miidhaan kun jibba sanyummaarratti kan hundaa'e ta'uu waan mirkaneesseef, adabbiin cimaan irratti kan murame yoo ta'u, irraa deebi'anii poolisii ta'uu akka hin dandeenye dhorkamaniiru.

title: In a year of AI solving maths problems, Anthropic may have just solved the biggest
english: A mathematician working with Anthropic has claimed to have used the company's Claude AI to develop a proof for the 170-year-old Riemann hypothesis. This complex mathematical problem, which focuses on the order of prime numbers, is considered one of the most significant challenges in the field. While the massive 250,000-line proof is currently being reviewed by experts, its potential verification would mark a major milestone in both mathematics and artificial intelligence.
amharic: ከአንትሮፒክ ኩባንያ ጋር የሚሰራ የሂሳብ ሊቅ፣ የኩባንያውን ክላውድ (Claude) የተሰኘ አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ በመጠቀም የ170 ዓመት ዕድሜ ያለውን የሪማን መላምት (Riemann hypothesis) መፍትሄ ማግኘቱን አስታውቋል። ይህ የቁጥር ስርዓትን በተለይም የዋና ቁጥሮችን ቅደም ተከተል የሚያጠናው ውስብስብ የሂሳብ ችግር፣ በዘርፉ ትልቅ ግኝት ተደርጎ ይታያል። ምንም እንኳን የ250,000 መስመር ያህል ርዝመት ያለው ይህ መፍትሄ አሁን በባለሙያዎች እየተጣራ ቢሆንም፣ ከተረጋገጠ ግን በሂሳብ እና በቴክኖሎጂ ታሪክ ውስጥ ትልቅ ለውጥ የሚያመጣ ይሆናል።
oromo: Hayyuun barnoota herregaa tokko kan dhaabbata Anthropic waliin hojjatu, of-koollee AI (Claude) fayyadamuun furmaata yaada sakatta’iinsa Riemann (Riemann hypothesis) kan waggaa 170 lakkoofsise argachuu isaa beeksiseera. Rakkoon herregaa kun kan xiyyeeffatu tartiiba lakkoofsoota bu’uuraa irratti yoo ta’u, sadarkaa idil-addunyaatti qormaata guddaa keessaa tokko dha. Furmaanni inni dhiyeesse kun qajeeltoo 250,000 kan of keessatti qabatu yoo ta’u, ammaaf ogeeyyiin kan ilaala jiran; mirkanaa’uu isaa irraa kaasees hiika guddaa kan qabu ta’a.

title: Can Africa’s new credit rating agency change how the continent is assessed?
english: The African Union has launched the Africa Credit Rating Agency to provide independent and localized financial assessments for the continent's governments and businesses. This initiative aims to address concerns that global agencies often misjudge African economic risks, which has historically led to higher borrowing costs. By using local data, the agency hopes to improve transparency and fairness, though it must prove its credibility to international investors to be effective.
amharic: የአፍሪካ ህብረት ለአፍሪካ መንግስታት እና ኩባንያዎች ገለልተኛ የብድር ደረጃ መመዘኛ ለመስጠት የአፍሪካ ክሬዲት ሬቲንግ ኤጀንሲን በይፋ አቋቁሟል። ይህ ተቋም ዓለም አቀፍ ተቋማት የአፍሪካን ኢኮኖሚ አቅም በትክክል ሳይገመግሙ በመቅረታቸው ለሚፈጠረው ከፍተኛ የወለድ ጫና መፍትሄ ለመፈለግ ያለመ ነው። ኤጀንሲው የአካባቢውን መረጃ በመጠቀም ግልጽነትን ለማረጋገጥ ቢሞክርም፣ ተዓማኒነቱን ለማረጋገጥ ከዓለም አቀፍ ባለሀብቶች እምነት ማግኘት ይጠበቅበታል።
oromo: Gamtaan Afrikaa mootummootaafi dhaabbilee Afrikaaf madaallii dinagdee ofdanda'aa ta'e kennuuf 'Africa Credit Rating Agency' jedhamu hundeesseera. Ejansichi kan hundaa'eef, dhaabbileen madaallii idil-addunyaa diinagdee Afrikaa sirriitti hubachuu dhabuun isaanii biyyoota Afrikaa irratti baasii liqii ulfaataa waan geessisuufi. Ejansichi odeeffannoo naannichaa fayyadamuun iftoominaafi madaallii sirrii ta'e fiduuf kan yaalu yoo ta'u, milkaa'ina isaaf amanamummaa gabaa idil-addunyaa argachuun dirqama ta'a.

title: Denmark expels Russian diplomat over alleged plot to kill Ukrainian rapper
english: Denmark has ordered the expulsion of a Russian defense official following allegations that Russian intelligence orchestrated a plot to assassinate a Ukrainian rapper at a Copenhagen concert. Danish authorities arrested three individuals after discovering weapons in a vehicle near the venue, linking the plan to a banned local street gang. In response to this unprecedented aggressive act, the government is also considering restricting Russian access to Schengen visas.
amharic: ዴንማርክ በኮፐንሃገን ኮንሰርት ላይ የዩክሬን ራፐርን ለመግደል በሩሲያ የስለላ ድርጅት ተጠንስሷል የተባለውን ሴራ ተከትሎ የሩሲያን የመከላከያ አታሼ ከሀገር እንዲወጡ አዝዛለች። የዴንማርክ ባለስልጣናት በኮንሰርቱ አካባቢ በተደረገ ፍተሻ የጦር መሳሪያ የያዙ ሶስት ሰዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር ያዋሉ ሲሆን፣ ሴራውም በሀገሪቱ ታግዶ ከነበረ ወንጀለኛ ቡድን ጋር ግንኙነት እንዳለው ገልጸዋል። ይህንን ያልተለመደ የጥቃት ሙከራ ተከትሎ መንግስት በሩሲያውያን ላይ ተጨማሪ የቪዛ ገደቦችን ለመጣል እያሰበ ነው።
oromo: Deenmaark qindeessituu basaastota Raashiyaa tokko, sirbaarratti raapparaa Yukreenii tokko ajjeesuuf karoora baafatamee ture himachuun biyyattiirraa ariitee jirti. Qorattoonni nageenyaa Deenmaark konkolaataa iddoo sirbichaa biratti qabameen meeshaa waraanaa argachuun namoota sadii to'annoo jala oolchaniiru; karoora kana keessattis garee yakkaarraa dhorkame tokkotu hirmaachuu himame.
